about: ASSET-003 early repaint recipe (troll_repaint.py). Mask = kit/repaint/lox_hive_mask.png in the Lox Body's UV0 (the atlas Furr1 shares) (R bark, G extremity darkening, B blight veins = emission, A dark roots + mouth). Colours are linear multipliers applied to the texture's stored (sRGB-encoded) texel values, as the runtime reads them back with GetPixels. The vanilla luminance is kept everywhere (lum / mean lum), so the anatomy still reads.
bark_texture: olivetree_trunk01 (TheHive_Mat _MainTex), triplanar in rest-pose metres, tile 1.2 m
mask_size: 512 (computed at 1024, box-filtered); the vanilla Lox texture is 256, the runtime paints a 512 copy
blight_emission: BlightGlow, driven by the biome tint at runtime
fur_note: Furr1 (fur cards, 1,744 tris) is HIDDEN; the Body's own painted fur is repainted

moss.how: albedo = lerp(albedo, moss_colour x vanilla luminance, R)
